blocked_actions.reason: destructive change requiring change board approval, out of scope
security-sensitive change requiring security approval, out of scope
broad infra scaling requiring separate approval, out of scope

rationale: Incident scope explicitly permits only checkout diagnostics, forbidding destructive data changes and broad regional capacity actions.
Destructive and security-sensitive changes carry high risk of data loss or security breach, requiring formal approval gates.
Policy mandates escalation to change board for destructive changes and to security for credential changes, establishing clear approval boundaries.
